name: 10566 · Peekskill, NY
findings: ZIP 10566 (Peekskill) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10566 (Peekskill) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
